name: clamp
sig: genType clamp(genType x, genType minV, genType maxV)
note: Returns min(max(x,minV),maxV). Common for keeping colors in [0,1].

name: mix
sig: genType mix(genType a, genType b, genType t)

name: smoothstep
note: Hermite interpolation; 0 below edge0, 1 above edge1. edge0 must be < edge1.

name: fract
note: x - floor(x). Core of most procedural/noise patterns.
